svg.aria-label: Jar tests for soil and sand
svg.text: Fill a straight-sided jar ⅓ with soil, add water
to ¾ and a pinch of dish soap. Shake 2–3 min.
Mark the top of each layer as it settles; layer
Same jar, but only 2 in of sand and clean water to ¾.
Floating dark specks or tea-colored water = organic
matter (leaves, peat): weakens and slows concrete.
